content.query:
WITH TEMP_TBL AS (
select accountid, bank_id, core_cust_id, max(left(right(file_name,12),8)) SCD_Start_date from EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM where left(right(file_name,12),8) < '20240405'
GROUP BY  accountid, bank_id, core_cust_id
)
UPDATE A
SET A.SCD_END_DATE = CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)
FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM A
JOIN TEMP_TBL B ON A.accountid = B.accountid AND A.bank_id = B.bank_id AND A.core_cust_id = B.core_cust_id AND CONVERT(DATE,A.SCD_Start_date) = CONVERT(DATE, B.SCD_Start_date);
